provenance.locator: Curated providerId to sourceRecordId acceptances for exact same-county Ministry map rows that publish coordinates but do not expose street-address evidence.
provenance.note: Acceptances are only coordinate evidence. The provider-point builder verifies exact normalised provider/source name equality, same county, published coordinates, Romania bounds, service-access eligibility, non-county-only provider placement, missing street-address evidence and source-record uniqueness.

limitations.text: These acceptances must not fill provider addresses. They only approve directly published Ministry map coordinates for exact same-county source rows without street-address evidence.

This file does not enable fuzzy matching. Each accepted row is pinned to one ANMCS provider id and one Ministry source record id, and the builder rejects non-exact normalised names, county mismatches, reused source records and source rows with street-address evidence.
